title: Abort a run's repair handoff
description: End a run paused for your repair without resuming it: the run ends failed on the failed block's typed endpoint, keeping the rows it saved and reporting its coverage (dsagent.execution.get / wait). Use it when the block cannot be repaired on the page. Requires an idempotency key.

handoffId.description: The handoff to act on: pause.handoffId of dsagent.execution.get / wait.

runToken.description: The run's ownership token, as dsagent.execution.run or dsagent.wizard.run returned it (shown once). Pass it when your browser connection was renewed (a restarted Connector): the run, its open repair handoff and its pages follow you to the new connection. Not needed on the connection that started the run.

executionId.description: The run, now ending failed; read its outcome with dsagent.execution.wait.
